description: Generic overall opinion and satisfaction with the product without focusing on a specific feature.
examples: worst face wash I have ever used

description: How well the cleanser removes dirt, sweat, oil, makeup residue, and impurities from the skin.
examples: does not remove all the oil

description: Hydration and moisture retention after cleansing, including whether the skin feels soft or dry.
examples: does not dry out my face

description: Perceived quality, safety, and formulation of the ingredients used in the product.
Effect on pimples, clogged pores, acne, and skin congestion.
Physical feel and consistency of the product during and after application.
Any irritation, redness, burning, itching, or allergic reaction caused by the product.
Amount of product received and how long it lasts relative to expectations.
Perceived value for money based on price, performance, and longevity.
